info.name: Gizra API — Customer, Restaurant & Driver
info.description:
Complete API surface for the Gizra delivery platform, generated directly from the Laravel route table and controller validation rules.

Every parameter shown is one the backend actually reads. Required fields are pre-filled in the body or enabled as query params; optional fields are listed in each request description and left disabled.

## Getting a token
1. Run the relevant **Login** request (Auth folder in each app section).
2. Copy `token` from the response into the matching collection variable (`customer_token`, `vendor_token`, `dm_token`).

## Variables
`base_url` defaults to production. Change it to point at staging.
